messages:
maya-csm: Quick flag - Nimbus onboarding caused a big embed surge overnight. Can we 15m triage to add a short-term cost gate before QBR? :wave:
owen-finops: Saw a jump from ~2k -> ~50k tokens/day for the cohort. Projected extra monthly ~$6k if sustained. Recommend provisional cap + alerts. :money_with_wings:
liam-embed-ops: We can enable batching on batch-embed endpoint now and add a soft daily cap + feature-flagged throttle. Adaptive caching next sprint.
sarah-qa: If we add throttle, define response contract so I can test clients. 429 + JSON body + X-Soft-Throttle header sounds fine.
maya-csm: Proposed alerts: thresholds 50/80/95% of daily_cap=60k, soft_throttle at 90% with override. I'll tell Nimbus and add to QBR slide.
own-finops: Draft alert rule: daily_cap=60000; thresholds=[50,80,90]; notify=[maya-csm,owen-finops]; escalate if >120% for 2h -> pager.
costbot: Policy created: nimbus-embed-guard-3333334444. Notifications to #customer-success and owen-finops@redwood.internal.
nora-customer: Thanks	6 please enable batching and we'll share top-10 prompts + expected concurrency.
maya-csm: Liam + Sarah, please add a 5-point test checklist and error contract to the shared QBR doc (https://redwood.internal/qbrs/nimbus). Owen, add conservative spend table and renewal-risk note. Aim to close before Friday so QBR slide shows mitigations. :thumbsup:
